name: Leah Myers
source:
Leah Myers is a writer and a potential love interest for Main Character. She is first seen in Book 1, Chapter 9.

Leah has a very laid-back personality. She is described as "clever, talented, and [doesn't] take crap" by Main Character; the two eventually start a lifestyle blog together. When Main Character first meets her at the ClickIt offices, she is introduced by Martin as a "rockstar of the clickbait world." 

[spoiler]Despite her calm and confident exterior, Leah holds painful memories from being psychologically abused by her ex-girlfriend, Camilla. This is especially relevant in Book 2 when Camilla appears in Leah's life once again.[/spoiler]

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Leah_Myers]Wiki[/url]]
